name: Ruin Stance
description: Sink into a stance that spends no strength on defence and keeps all of it for the blow.

name: Wreck Step
description: Stamp forward so hard that the ground cracks and the foe loses its footing.

name: Mending Breath
description: Breathe through the dust of a fight and let the settling qi seal the cuts of yourself or an ally.

name: Battered Resolve
description: Take each blow as fuel and let the pain turn into steadier strength in your limbs.

name: Collapse Frame
description: Fall into the foe with the whole body and bring its guard and stance down together.

name: Shattering Hide
description: Harden the hide until each blow that lands on it breaks something of the striker.

name: Breakneck Charge
description: Hurl the body forward in a run that does not slow for blows or foes in its path.

name: Marrow Restoration
description: Spend marrow warmth in a deep restoration of the bones and flesh of yourself or an ally.

name: Ruin Hammer
description: Bring the whole frame down in one great blow that breaks the ground in a wide circle.

name: Colossus Guard
description: Swell the frame with qi to a colossal hardness that no weapon of the realm can bite.

name: Venom Burnout
description: Burn out every trace of venom and taint from the blood of yourself or an ally in one fever.

name: Colossus Fall
description: School blow in which the body falls on the foe as a titan would and the ground bursts about it.

name: Ruin Incarnate
description: Spend the whole reserve in one blow whose reach is the destructive ceiling of the realm and shatters whatever it meets.

name: Dense Charge
description: Charge on Core weight and strike through the first foe that stands in the way.

name: Core Bracing
description: Pack the Core's qi into the legs and trunk to bear a blow that would drive a lesser frame down.

name: Furnace Revival
description: Stoke the Core as a furnace and drive its warmth through the worn body of yourself or an ally.

name: Dross Burning
description: Burn the dross of poison and taint from the blood of yourself or an ally with Core heat.

name: Juggernaut Drive
description: Drive through a line of foes and throw them aside by the weight alone.

name: Unyielding Hide
description: Harden the skin with Core qi until blades and clubs turn aside as from stone.

name: Momentum Store
description: Bank the force of a charge in the Core and release it into the next blow.

name: Trample
description: Run over the foes in front with the stamp of the Core in every step.

name: Behemoth Heave
description: Lift a foe or a heavy thing and hurl it with the full strength of the Core.

name: Unmoving Frame
description: Stand unmoved by any push as the Core locks the frame to the ground.

name: Blazing Vitality
description: Pour a blaze of Core vitality into yourself or an ally to knit wounds and renew strength.

name: Endless Frame
description: School blow in which the Core-driven frame advances and cannot be turned back or broken.

name: Overwhelming Mass
description: Hurl the full weight of the Core-driven frame at the foe with the destructive ceiling of the realm.

name: Unstoppable Surge
description: Run through every guard and wall in the path at the speed of the Core and break them all.

name: Divine Anchor
description: Root the frame in the world with divine energy so no force can shift it.

name: Presence Weight
description: Let the weight of the anchored body press on the air so lesser foes slow and stoop.

name: Ever-Mending
description: Let divine energy mend the flesh of yourself or an ally without pause through the fight.

name: Plague Cleansing
description: Push divine energy through the blood of yourself or an ally and cast out plague and curse.

name: Rooted Blow
description: Root the stance in the world and strike so the force has the whole earth to push against.

name: World Hide
description: Draw the strength of the world into the skin so even a divine edge only scratches it.

name: Foot of Ages
description: Stamp one foot and let the shock carry the body across the ground to the target.

name: Divine Repair
description: Restore a body torn open by the strike of a far stronger foe with the repair of anchored flesh.

name: Pillar of Presence
description: Stand and let the anchored body press down on every foe about until none can rise.

name: Unshakable Throne
description: Sit the frame upon the world so that no blow can unseat it.

name: Heavenly Cleansing
description: Drive every curse and soul taint out of the body of yourself or an ally with divine energy.

name: Anchor Descent
description: School blow in which the anchored body comes down and the world itself bears the blow with it.

name: Worldfall Body
description: School blow in which the body falls as a part of the world and the foe is thrown from it.

name: Earthbreak Fall
description: Bring the anchored body down upon the foe with the destructive ceiling of the divine realm.

name: Obliterating Mass
description: Let the full weight of the anchored body fall on one place and leave nothing standing in it.
